limits: Static target judgments apply under stated assumptions. No runtime exploit, fixed-control validation or benchmark scan was performed.
Selection emphasizes contextual reasoning; traditional scanner misses and AI advantages remain unmeasured.
Hashes establish consistency, not signed provider authenticity or semantic truth. No Mythos 5.1 invocation is claimed.
Raw sources, receipts, response files and packets are local ignored artifacts. Replay requires them and the Twenty case-sensitive volume mounted at its recorded path.
Current adapters do not declare Java/Ruby support: six labels across four inputs remain unsupported until capabilities are verified.
Existing legacy human-reviewed reporting scopes are not satisfied by these machine sidecars; no human approvals or admissions were manufactured.
